parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: The ID of the agent, which corresponds to the RAM ID.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the call center.

parameters.name: PhoneNumber
parameters.description: The phone number of the call center for which to retrieve data.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the historical data to retrieve. Default value: 0, which indicates 00:00 of the current day.

parameters.name: StopTime
parameters.description: The end time of the historical data to retrieve. Default value: 0, which indicates the current time.
